program.title: BSc in Biotechnology
uncertain: total_required_credits (109.0) is the sum of the required_credits of all groups. The program has a mandatory International Research Enrichment (IRE) Track plus two mutually exclusive Tracks (Applied Bioscience and Entrepreneurship), so the sum double-counts: the Applied Bioscience Track (9+9=18) and the Entrepreneurship Track (19) overlap only partially, and the IRE Track (6) plus the 'Others' group (18, which restates the Applied Bioscience Track) are both enumerated. A realistic total is the core (pre-req 0 + lab 0 + required 18 + capstone 3 + chemistry 6+2+3+1 = 33) plus the IRE Track (+6) plus electives (15-18) plus a chosen Track (Applied Bioscience 18 or Entrepreneurship 19) = ~72-89.
Several blocks allow alternative course choices with credit ranges (pre-req 0-3, lab 0-1, capstone 3-7, elective 15-18), so actual credits may differ.
The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 BIOT (4Y) (2026-27 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2026-27 intake curriculum.

groups.name: Elective(s)
groups.note: Biotechnology Electives (Courses from the specified elective list. Students following IRE Track are required to take a minimum of 15 credits. Courses taken as Major/Track Required Courses may not be counted towards the elective requirement.) 'LIFS Any LIFS courses at 3000/4000-level' is a free choice; the enumerated printed courses are listed below.

Data Science Foundation for Biotech Innovation
Principles and Applications of Environmental Science

groups.name: Applied Bioscience Track Required Course(s)
groups.note: Students in the Applied Bioscience Track should also take LIFS 3040, LIFS 3060, and LIFS 4370 as specified in the major requirements.

groups.name: Applied Bioscience Track Elective Course(s)
groups.note: Applied Bioscience Track Elective (Courses from the specified elective list, with at least one course from each of the three areas: Cellular and Molecular Biology, Computational and Data Science, and Commercialization).

groups.name: Entrepreneurship Track Required Course(s)
groups.note: Students in the Entrepreneurship Track should also take LIFS 2888, LIFS 3110, LIFS 3140, LIFS 4200, and LIFS 4630 as specified in the major requirements.

courses.name: Data Science Foundation for Biotech Innovation
Biotechnological Application of Recombinant DNA Techniques
The Biotechnology Business: From Idea to Bankability

groups.name: International Research Enrichment Track Required Course(s)
groups.note: Students in the IRE Track should also take SCIE 4500 and LIFS 4983 as specified in the major requirements.

groups.name: Others
groups.note: With approval by the program office, students should follow the Applied Bioscience Track and complete all of its requirements (Applied Bioscience Track Required 9 + Applied Bioscience Track Elective 9 = 18).
